cards.reason_note: You are being handed to your system browser to sign in with the provider.
cards.data_exit_note: Sign-in happens on the provider in your system browser; only the sign-in request leaves Aureline.
cards.fallback_note: If the browser does not open, you can retry the sign-in from within Aureline.

local_continuity.continuity_note: Your current work stays open in Aureline while you sign in.

return_anchor.return_path_truth_note: After you sign in, the browser returns you to this Aureline window.

cards.card_summary: Opens your system browser to sign in with the provider, then returns you to Aureline.

cards.reason_note: Enter the one-time device code shown here at the provider to authorize this device.
cards.data_exit_note: Aureline shows the code for you to type at the provider; no payload is transmitted by Aureline.

device_code_disclosure.expiry_note: The code expires shortly and is shown with a live countdown.

cards.fallback_note: If the browser does not open, you can enter the device code manually at the provider.

local_continuity.continuity_note: Your work stays open while you authorize the device code.

return_anchor.return_path_truth_note: Once you authorize the code, Aureline continues in this window.

cards.card_summary: Shows a one-time device code and its expiry to enter at the provider, keeping your work local.

cards.reason_note: This opens provider-owned content in your browser; the content is not Aureline chrome.
cards.data_exit_note: Opens the provider's public content in your browser; you browse it as an external page.
cards.fallback_note: If the browser does not open, you can copy the link to open it manually.

local_continuity.continuity_note: Aureline keeps your place while you view the provider content.

return_anchor.return_path_truth_note: Close the browser tab to come back to this Aureline window.

cards.headline_label: View provider content in your browser
cards.card_summary: Opens provider-owned content as an external browser page, clearly labeled as provider-owned.

cards.reason_note: This opens a vendor / third-party resource in your browser, outside Aureline.
cards.data_exit_note: Opens a vendor / third-party page in your browser; the outbound request leaves Aureline.
cards.fallback_note: If the browser does not open, you can copy the link to open it manually.

local_continuity.continuity_note: Your Aureline session stays intact while the vendor page opens.

return_anchor.return_path_truth_note: Switch back to Aureline to continue where you left off.

cards.headline_label: Open a vendor link in your browser
cards.card_summary: Opens a vendor / third-party resource in your browser, disclosing that it leaves Aureline.
